notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.description: The New York City Department of Social Services (DSS)/Human Resources Administration (HRA), through Adult Protective Services (APS), seeks to procure a qualified vendor through a competitive Request for Proposal (RFP) to design, develop, and deliver Community Guardian Program (CGP) Training Services. The purpose of this procurement is to establish a standardized training program that equips Community Guardian staff with the knowledge, skills, and resources needed to effectively serve vulnerable adults under Article 81 of the New York State Mental Hygiene Law. This procurement will support APSs ongoing commitment to workforce development by implementing a comprehensive training program that promotes consistent practices, strengthens professional competencies, and provides continuous learning opportunities for Community Guardian staff. The initiative will enhance operational effectiveness, promote program consistency across Community Guardian providers, and support the delivery of services to APS clients. The anticipated contract term is July 1, 2027 through June 30, 2029, with an estimated contract value of $578,011. Questions regarding this RFx must be transmitted in writing to …
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration is seeking bids from vendors to design and deliver training for Community Guardian Program staff who serve vulnerable adults, with a contract term of July 1, 2027 through June 30, 2029, an estimated value of $578,011, and responses due Dec. 11, 2026.

notices.short_title: COMPASS Programs in Public Schools - Middle
notices.description:
COMPASS and SONYC is one of DYCD's largest programs, with over 820 programs collectively throughout the five boroughs. Families rely on these programs to provide elementary and middle school students, during after school hours, summer and on holidays, programing which includes educational support, recreation, enrichment, and cultural activities to support and strengthen the overall development of our youth. Programs are offered at no cost to youth and are purposefully located in public and private schools, community centers, religious institutions, public housing and parks recreational facilities throughout the City to help families find a place that best fits their youth's needs.

Bronx 04 - Middle School - 84X461: Nuasin Next Generation Charter School
notices.plain: The Department of Youth and Community Development awarded Social Justice Network Inc a $3.51 million contract to run COMPASS after-school and holiday programs for middle school students in public schools, selected from competing proposals.
